verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an API-first service. It ships official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, a public OpenAPI spec, API-token auth and async long-running operations, so automation can drive it without a UI. Its llms.txt also documents isolated per-test namespaces, which supports CI testing directly. Missing for 10: an official CLI, a dedicated CI/automation guide, programmatic token provisioning (tokens are created in the dashboard), a stable OpenAPI spec (the repo warns of breaking changes), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
